items.question: To which specific deity must the bali offering be given after designation?
premises: The ritual context prescribes the act of giving an offering.
The offering must be directed toward a specific recipient.
Designation of the deity precedes the act of giving.
items.inference: Therefore, one should give the offering to that particular deity after having designated it.
items.plain_english: Having designated that particular deity, one should give the offering to that deity.
